records.title: Unlocking Academic Success  How UK Essays’ Systematic Literature Review Service Just Got Better
records.description: If you’ve been asked to complete a systematic literature review and you’re feeling overwhelmed by the methodology, documentation requirements, or sheer amount of work involved, this video breaks everything down clearly. We take a deep look at the systematic literature review service offered by UK Essays and explain exactly what you get, how it works, and why the service has become far more affordable thanks to the brand-new pricing update introduced in November 2025. This is especially important for students working on major assignments, dissertations, or theses where systematic reviews are required. First, we explain what a systematic literature review actually is and how it differs from a normal literature review. A systematic review requires a precise research question, documented search strategies, strict inclusion and exclusion criteria, structured screening, quality appraisal, and detailed data extraction tables. It’s one of the hardest academic tasks to complete correctly because every decision must be transparent, justified, and reproducible. Many students underestimate the amount of technical work involved until they’re already deep into the process. Then we focus on how UK Essays approaches this task. Despite the name, UK Essays is an international academic support company based in Dubai and serving clients around the world. Their researchers come from global academic backgrounds, not just the UK. The name reflects the British standard of academic excellence rather than the location of their customers or staff. Students from Europe, Asia, Africa, Australia, North America, and the Middle East use the service, and the company matches each project with a subject specialist who understands the academic expectations of the client’s region. We explore the two different versions of the service that UK Essays offers. The full systematic review package includes everything: the development of your PICO or PEO research framework, complete search strategy documentation, search terms tables, inclusion and exclusion criteria tables, search screenshots, PRISMA flow diagrams, CASP quality appraisal checklists, and detailed data extraction tables such as study characteristics and literature matrix templates. This version is ideal for Masters and PhD students whose universities require complete methodological transparency. For students who want professional help but at a lower cost, the company also offers a cheaper version of the service without all the extras. In this case, the expert writes the systematic review itself while you complete the tables and documentation, or choose which components you want to handle personally. This flexible structure means students can customise the service based on budget, confidence and academic requirements. A key part of this video is the pricing update. As of November 2025, UK Essays introduced significantly cheaper prices for systematic literature reviews, making the service far more competitive than many other providers. This pricing shift matters because systematic reviews traditionally require more expert time and technical labour, which made them one of the more expensive academic services. The new pricing model lowers the barrier for students who need structured help but previously found full-service costs too high. We also look at the advantages of being able to submit your own materials. If you’ve already completed your database searches, compiled study lists, or begun your extraction work, you can hand that over and let a specialist complete the remaining tasks. This is especially useful for students who start confidently but become overwhelmed when the documentation requirements become more complex. By the end of the video, you’ll understand exactly what a systematic literature review requires, what UK Essays provides, how the two service levels differ, and why the new pricing update makes the service more accessible to students worldwide. With global researchers, international customers, and a brand reputation built on high academic standards, UK Essays offers one of the most flexible and cost-effective systematic review services available today. If you’re preparing for a dissertation, thesis, or major academic assessment and want expert support, this deep breakdown will help you decide whether the full or the cheaper streamlined version of the service is the right fit for your needs. Whether you’re studying in the UK, Malaysia, Canada, the Middle East, South Africa, Europe or anywhere else, this video explains how to use the service effectively and what to expect from each stage of the process. Learn more here: https://www.ukessays.com/services/systematic-literature-review.php

records.title: How to Get Your Master’s Degree in Record Time: Secrets No One Talks About
records.description: Master’s degree help, dissertation writing, research proposal writing, literature review, thesis time management, supervisor feedback, and postgraduate success – this book was written for every master’s student who is tired of feeling stuck. Are you doing your master’s degree and feeling overwhelmed, delayed, confused, or emotionally exhausted? Maybe your proposal is taking too long. Maybe your supervisor’s feedback is slow. Maybe your literature review is draining you. Maybe work, family, money, and research are all fighting for your attention. Maybe you keep saying, “I will submit next year” – but deep down, you are tired of waiting. This book is for you. 📘 How to Get Your Master’s Degree in Record Time: Secrets No One Talks About This practical book gives master’s students the hidden strategies many universities do not teach clearly enough: how to choose the right topic, manage your supervisor, plan your degree like a project, write your proposal, handle the literature review, collect data, stay motivated, edit your work, and submit with confidence. Whether you are studying at UNISA, UP, UJ, Wits, UKZN, NWU, UCT, TUT, DUT, CPUT, CUT, Rhodes, Stellenbosch, UFS, or any other university in South Africa or beyond, this book will help you stop drifting and start moving towards graduation. Your master’s degree should not steal years of your life. You do not need to be perfect. You need a plan. You need strategy. You need discipline. You need the right guidance. 📚 Get your copy today and start working towards finishing your master’s degree in record time. #MastersDegree #PostgraduateStudies #DissertationWriting #ThesisWriting #ResearchProposal #LiteratureReview #UNISA #SouthAfricanStudents #AcademicSuccess

records.description: The workshop aims to provide clear and practical guidance on the academic publication process, particularly for early-career philosophers seeking to develop their research into publishable journal articles. records.title: Types of Data | Quantitative Data | Qualitative Data | Primary Data | Secondary Data
records.description: In this video Faisal Nadeem shared 12 important types of data 1. Based on Nature Qualitative Data (Categorical) Descriptive, non-numeric information. Example: Colors, gender, names, opinions. Quantitative Data (Numerical) Measured in numbers. Example: Age, height, salary. 2. Based on Source Primary Data – Collected first-hand for a specific purpose. (e.g., surveys, experiments) Secondary Data – Already collected by someone else. (e.g., reports, books, databases) 3. Based on Time Cross-sectional Data – Collected at one point in time. (e.g., population census of 2025) Time-series Data – Collected over a period of time. (e.g., monthly sales data for 5 years) 4. Based on Measurement Scale (Stevens’ Classification) Nominal – Labels without order. (e.g., blood group, country name) Ordinal – Ordered categories, but differences are not measurable. (e.g., rankings, satisfaction level) Interval – Numeric scale with equal intervals, but no true zero. (e.g., temperature in °C) Ratio – Numeric scale with equal intervals and a true zero. (e.g., weight, length, income) 5. Based on Processing Raw Data – Original, unprocessed facts. Processed Data – Organized and analyzed form of data. This video cover the following types of data kinds of data types of data qualitative and quantitative types of data qualitative vs. quantitative qualitative data vs quantitative primary data and secondary data primary data and secondary data difference cross sectional data cross sectional data and time series data cross sectional data vs time series longitudinal data time series data vs cross sectional data raw data processeed data nominal data ordinal data interval data panel data cross sectional data cross sectional data and time series data cross sectional data vs time series or common job interview questions and answers or important job interview questions and answers completely explained by @Knowledge Topper with suitable examples.
